messages:
maya: Quick proposal for a small pilot: 'residency windows' — tenants request a preferred region for a fixed time window (30/90d) without hard pinning. Looking for feedback on risks and launch checklist.

ollie: Sounds promising. Two quick asks: express it in the routing DSL and add a console view for admins.

sanjay: Important: clarify eviction semantics. For hosted tiers we should allow graceful fallback; for Dedicated offer optional contract-backed pins. Emergency eviction only for major incidents and with notifications.

liz: Pilot requirements: dashboards (primary_coverage, fallback_rate, cost_delta), 3 pilot tenants (one PLG, two enterprise), and legal review of residency wording.

tomas: Infra notes: placement-sim needs a residency_hint signal (tenant, region, qps_estimate, window_end). Also watch cache locality: consider prefix warming on window start.

maya: Nice. Proposed pre-GA gates: DSL + API implemented, sim shows <10% p99 regression for other tenants at 5% windowed traffic, dashboards wired, KMS/logging regional opt-ins for data-residency, pilot telemetry collected.

deploy-bot: checklist added to board: routing-dsl PR, placement-sim job, console mock, KMS integration item.

ollie: I'll start a routing-dsl branch and add an example manifest.

maya: I'll draft a 1-page pilot charter + ADR and assign owners. If no objections, convert this to a runbook by Friday. :thumbsup:
